text: Hailstorm on the Cauberg during the team's openingsweekend. Page said rain jacket, and everybody had one. Coffee for you: buymeacoffee.com/berttemme.
name: Tijs Eekhoutte (Pro)

text: Fog over the Flemish Ardennes and I rode the Koppenberg like a rookie. At least I knew it from the page. Coffee at buymeacoffee.com/berttemme, as a thank-you.
name: Marthe Delcloo (Pro)

text: Perfect tailwind towards Zandvoort during the team ride, we hit 65 km/h in the final. Our mechanic is also a fan. Coffee to buymeacoffee.com/berttemme.
name: Rutger Zandstra (Pro)

text: Recovery ride in the Limburg hills with the girls from the team. Warm clothes at the start, off at the top, exactly like the page said. buymeacoffee.com/berttemme gets a coffee.
name: Evi Strijbosch (Pro)

text: Dropped my chain halfway up the Amerongse Berg (Noord), the king of the Heuvelrug, with half the group already over the top. The page warned about the wet roads. Coffee at buymeacoffee.com/berttemme for my pride.
name: Bas Vermaat

text: Ruiterberg in a 5 Bft headwind with my club: the page said gusts, my legs said no. We got over it, and buymeacoffee.com/berttemme got a round of coffee afterwards.
name: Liesbeth Aalbers

text: Flat tyre on the Grebbeberg, a short wall of 5 percent, just as the rain started. My brother-in-law still laughed at me. I paid buymeacoffee.com/berttemme a coffee because the jacket tip kept me dry.
name: Harold Nieuwenhuis

text: Leaves on the road at the Amerongse Berg and I slid out with my girlfriend right behind me. The warning was on the page, I just did not read it. Coffee: buymeacoffee.com/berttemme.
name: Rik Zomerdijk

text: My derailleur snapped on the Botterstop, so I walked the last 500 metres in cleats. Thanks to buymeacoffee.com/berttemme for at least telling me to bring a rain jacket.
name: Marjolein Spierenburg

text: Fog and ice on the Utrechtse Heuvelrug at 7 AM. Three of us walked up the Koerheuvel, the fourth rode and fell. Coffee at buymeacoffee.com/berttemme for the warning.
name: Floris Kersten

text: Brakes squealing on the long descent of the Amerongse Berg (Zuid), a muddy bike, a wet road. The cleaning advice was right! Coffee sent to buymeacoffee.com/berttemme.
name: Esmee van Ginkel

text: Spoke broke on the Ruiterberg with my father-in-law. We walked home through the forest. Nice day anyway, thanks to buymeacoffee.com/berttemme for the clothing advice.
name: Rob Hogendoorn

text: Hail on the Amerongse Berg and my riding buddies hid under a bridge. We lost a whole hour but kept our dry socks. A coffee at buymeacoffee.com/berttemme for the heads-up.
name: Jacqueline Dubbeldam

text: Cramps on the Botterstop, 90 km into a hot day with my old team. The humidity chips were right. buymeacoffee.com/berttemme gets a coffee and an apology for doubting it.
name: Gerrit Moerdijk

text: Lekdijk near Schoonhoven with my club, a straight 40 km into a 6 Bft headwind. The page called it, we rode in a tight line and shared a coffee at buymeacoffee.com/berttemme afterwards.
name: Arjen Vlot

text: Fog on the Lekdijk at Vianen, so thick I could not see my friend two bikes ahead. Lights on as the page said. A coffee for buymeacoffee.com/berttemme!
name: Sandra Ouwerkerk

text: Black ice on the Lekdijk near Jaarsveld with my husband. The warning kept us off the dyke until noon. Coffee to buymeacoffee.com/berttemme.
name: Dirk-Jan Verkerk

text: Westfriese Omringdijk, 143 km with five friends. Headwind from Medemblik to Hoorn, tailwind back, just like the compass said. We split a coffee via buymeacoffee.com/berttemme.
name: Mariska Bakker-Kuin

text: A chain snapped on the Omringdijk above the IJsselmeer near Enkhuizen, with the wind tearing at us. My buddy pushed me for 6 km. Buymeacoffee.com/berttemme gets a coffee for the gust warning.
name: Hein Visscher

text: Kitesurfers on the Omringdijk near Hoorn and a 7 Bft crosswind. I walked the last stretch with my girlfriend. Coffee sent to buymeacoffee.com/berttemme for being honest about it.
name: Femke Burger

text: Oosterscheldekering with the whole family: completely exposed, and the page had warned me, so we all wore windbreakers. Thanks, buymeacoffee.com/berttemme!
name: Jacco Van der Weele

text: Tailwind across the Brouwersdam with three friends, then a puncture right where the kitesurfers park. A coffee at buymeacoffee.com/berttemme for the dry weather at least.
name: Lotte Remijn

text: Veerse Gatdam in a stiff sidewind, my front wheel wobbled like crazy. My group stayed behind me in the lee. Coffee for the page at buymeacoffee.com/berttemme.
name: Pieter Kodde

text: Zeelandbrug at sunset with my partner, 4 Bft and a clear sky: score 8, just as predicted. We toasted with coffee via buymeacoffee.com/berttemme.
name: Cindy Stoutjesdijk
